Subject: Medivance capacity: request for temporary H100 substitution & reserve-hold

Hi team,

Quick escalation: Medivance (DL-2026-5512) is seeing a sudden production spike tied to a large in-silico screening run. They have a Dedicated A100 reserved pool but the model performance characteristics on H100 would reduce per-inference latency and cut run duration ~35%, which is critical for their next milestone on Dec 18.

They've asked for three non-standard asks for a 30-day window (target period: 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-30):
- Temporary GPU substitution: allow H100-equivalent allocation mapped to their reserved commit (no change to contract term).
- Reservation hold / preemption protection: keep the substituted capacity pinned for the month (no transient preemptions).
- Soft overage cap / rate concession: reduce short-term overage multiplier to 1.5x (normally 2.0x) on incremental usage during the window; Medivance proposes to accept a monthly cap on incremental spend.

Why this matters: customer execs say this work directly unlocks a reimbursement milestone. If we can help them complete the run in this window they will expand Dedicated capacity by 30% at renewal. Risk: H100 inventory is meaningful in our US pool in Dec. This would be a temporary shift and we'd revert mappings after 12/30.

Initial ask: exec sign-off to (A) permit H100 substitution, (B) approve a reservation hold through 2027-01-15, and (C) allow a one-month overage multiplier concession to 1.5x with a soft customer overage cap (we recommend $60k).

I've attached their performance sample (model_run_metrics.csv) and will follow-up with cost modeling in next message. If Aditya/Karthik can weigh in on acceptable commercial guardrails (cap, payback mechanics), I can draft the amendment for DocuSign.

Thanks,
Mina

A couple quick asks before I can sign off:
1) Cost impact estimate (net to Redwood) for swapping A100 -> H100 for 30 days and the revenue exposure with the 1.5x overage multiplier. Please include worst-case incremental spend at 95th percentile.
2) Proposed cap mechanics and clawback/payback language — I prefer a hard cap on Redwood liability (e.g., Medivance pays first $X, we cap at $60k overage and customer indemnifies amounts above).
3) Legal/Docs: we need a brief amendment (1 page) with DocuSign link; procurement insists on an explicit end date and reversion clause.

If the numbers fit ($60k max exposure and opportunity to convert to +30% commit), I'm inclined to approve. Can we get the cost calc today so I can review with finance?
